papers.claim: Las Vegas uniform multitape Turing machine; full certified prime factorization, expected L_N[1/3,105] time and deterministic workspace L_N[1/3,40].
papers.scope_limit: Does not give deterministic polynomial time, or resolve P vs NP/BPP. Constants and bit model matter.
papers.next_task: Audit uniformity, tail bounds, smoothness and all conditional dependencies; replay primality and product certificates on public synthetic integers; algorithm timing only after executable source.

papers.claim: Zero-error classical DLP in F_(p^n), with explicit nonmembership certificate; exp((2+o(1)) (ln n)^2 / ln ln ln n) for fixed p, stated uniform extensions.
papers.scope_limit: Not general prime-field, elliptic-curve, or all-characteristic DLP; expected not deterministic time.
papers.next_task: Check field presentation and subgroup certificate, characteristic growth hypotheses and uniformity; exhaustive tiny extension-field controls on synthetic inputs.

papers.claim: Deterministic polynomial bit-time rational 1/5-approximate Nash profile in rational [0,1] bimatrix games, maximum unilateral regret <=1/5.
papers.scope_limit: Fixed approximation threshold, not arbitrary-epsilon PTAS or exact Nash; not Unique Games or strongly polynomial LP.
papers.next_task: Check MaximinKiteNE branches, LP bit complexity and both regret inequalities; exact rational small-game controls and adversarial near-boundary payoffs.

papers.claim: Deterministic nontrivial divisor of every composite N in O(exp(3 (ln N)^(.75))); order splitting with supplied exponent and prime quadratic nonresidues.
papers.scope_limit: Subexponential is not polynomial; supplied p-1 multiple is an assumption. README equates exp(O(sqrt(log p) loglog p)) with L_p[1/2,O(1)], which does not follow by algebra; check exact theorem.
papers.next_task: Audit annihilation exponent bit-length and construction, perfect-power cases, order splitting and nonresidue bound; test only public synthetic instances and record exact gate/cost conventions.

papers.claim: For Boolean matrices of real rank r, Dcc <= 750*2^38*r^(1/2-5e-6) for r>=2 and monochromatic rectangle density >=2^(-2^38*r^(1/2-5e-6)).
papers.scope_limit: Exponent improvement is not polylog rank; enormous threshold and constants preclude ordinary finite tests of asymptotic gain.
papers.next_task: Audit Gaussian rounding, KL-stability reduction and threshold; exact small Boolean rank and monochromatic rectangle witnesses as definition fidelity only.

papers.claim: Simple undirected graphs on n>=4 with m>=1000n reconstructible from edge-deleted multiset; minimum degree >=2000 corollary.
papers.scope_limit: M078 is vertex-deleted deck conjecture. Edge threshold first feasible at n=2001; no tiny graph can test theorem range. Edge reconstruction does not imply polynomial GI.
papers.next_task: Audit edge-vs-vertex deck convention, multiplicities, isolated vertices and density reduction; verify min-degree implication and known small edge-deck collision as out-of-scope negative control.

papers.claim: Explicit rational skew-symmetric zero-sum games with N_d=4d^2+14d-10 and fixed lexicographic simultaneous FP, tie-free t>=2, gap >=kappa_d*T^(-1/(d+1)) eventually.
papers.scope_limit: Lower bound on one dynamical algorithm, not hardness of finding equilibrium. Concurrent independent work arXiv:2610.08768; novelty not assessed.
papers.next_task: Reproduce published rational gadgets and initial conditions, tie audit and exact gap traces; compare concurrent construction; finite traces cannot prove eventual rate.

papers.claim: Independent monotone subadditive buyers, static anonymous prices: O(log log log m) upper approximation and Omega(log log log m/log log log log m) lower bound with two buyers.
papers.scope_limit: Not all pricing or adaptive mechanisms; asymptotic iterated logarithms need large m. Gap remains.
papers.next_task: Audit valuation subadditivity, independence, arrival/tie model and randomized price lower bound; enumerate tiny valuations and welfare for definition fidelity.

papers.claim: Binary VC dimension d admits compression O(d^2 log^2 d), a claimed polynomial-size resolution.
papers.scope_limit: Linear O(d) conjecture remains; size vs side information, reconstruction model and small d need precise theorem.
papers.next_task: Audit compression/decompression, consistency and side-information accounting; exhaust finite concept classes with exact VC dimension and reconstruction controls.

papers.claim: Randomized algorithms for 1/d-approximate normal-form CE in two-player strongly convex quadratic games on unit balls need exp(Omega(d^(1/16))) first-order oracle queries at success >=2/3.
papers.scope_limit: Oracle-query lower bound not explicit-input Turing hardness, not Nash, not unrestricted computational intractability.
papers.next_task: Audit first-order indistinguishability, cost range, convexity/Lipschitz and CE deviations; small exact quadratic controls with oracle-vs-explicit model separation.
